name: linear-pipeline
description: The simplest possible workflow: a straight three-step chain with no conditions — fetch a page (tool), summarize it (llm), record the result (echo). Demonstrates sequential dependency edges, a required run parameter referenced from step config, and an explicit retry policy on the network-bound step (ADR-006; the other steps inherit engine defaults).

config.prompt:
Summarize the following page in three bullet points:

${{ steps.fetch.output.body }}
